_comment: Running list of player-facing patch notes for the NEXT release. As work ships, append entries here. The patch-notes skill rolls this into Assets/data/patchnotes.json on release and clears pending. Categories: feature, balance, fix, polish, content.

entries.line: +50% XP all launch week — every beast and tamer gains 50% bonus XP through May 5 to celebrate the s&box launch. The boost auto-applies; nothing to claim, nothing to equip.

Live announcements ticker now also drives in-game XP/gold boosts — server-pushed events with a boost type and multiplier light up across battles and expeditions automatically (no client patch required for future event runs).

Clearing the first expedition now actually unlocks the second one. The cleared-counter was being stored against the real-zones-only chain but read against the full chain (which includes the tutorial), so every real zone was off by one and stayed locked behind itself.
